### call 1: node=spark-1 timeout=30 check=False
set -u
body=$(curl -fsS --max-time 10 http://127.0.0.1:8888/metrics 2>/dev/null) \
  || exit 3
printf '%s\n' "$body" | grep -E '^(vllm:|process_start_time_seconds )' \
  | grep -vE '_(bucket|created)\{' | head -n 1000 \
  | cut -c1-2000 || true
### call 2: node=spark-1 timeout=30 check=False
set -u
body=$(curl -fsS --max-time 10 http://192.0.2.10:11434/metrics 2>/dev/null) \
  || exit 3
printf '%s\n' "$body" | grep -E '^(vllm:|process_start_time_seconds )' \
  | grep -vE '_(bucket|created)\{' | head -n 1000 \
  | cut -c1-2000 || true
### call 3: node=spark-1 timeout=30 check=False
set -u
if [ -z "$(journalctl -k -b -n 1 -q --no-pager 2>/dev/null)" ]; then
  echo 'no kernel log of this boot is readable for the node user'
  exit 0
fi
journalctl -k -b -q --no-pager --no-hostname -o short-iso 2>/dev/null \
  | grep -E 'NVRM: Xid|fallen off the bus' | tail -n 500 \
  | cut -c1-2000 || true
### end
